_comment: Mutation testing (LIFT-667). Scoped to high-value, deterministic, DOM-free pure logic in src/lib/. Coverage measures execution; mutation testing measures assertion strength — it mutates source (flips conditionals, swaps operators, strips returns) and reports which mutants the suite fails to kill. Run on demand with `npm run test:mutation`; it is intentionally NOT part of CI (too slow for every PR). Keep the mutate list narrow so a full run stays fast and deterministic.
